description: Pattern-to-resource-pack map for DevSkyy task router. First-match-wins. Patterns matched case-insensitively against user prompt. Each pack lists skills/agents/plugins recommended for that task domain.

patterns.name: wordpress
patterns.note: Two themes: wordpress-theme/skyyrose-flagship (V1 'SkyyRose', text domain skyyrose, SKYYROSE_VERSION, builds via wordpress-theme/package.json) and wordpress-theme/skyyrose-flagship-2 ('SkyyRose Flagship 2', text domain skyyrose-flagship-2, SKYYROSE2_VERSION, its own package.json). Name which theme before editing; each has a scoped CLAUDE.md.

patterns.name: catalog
patterns.note: Product SOT = wordpress-theme/skyyrose-flagship/data/logo-registry.json (root symlink logo-registry.json), read via `from skyyrose.core.product import get_product` / `python -m skyyrose.core.product <sku>`. skyyrose-catalog.csv, dossiers, sot-images.json and collection sot.json are generated projections — never the source. Writes go through the registry update API, then `python scripts/sync_product_registry.py` (`--check` before handoff). Corey (founder) is authoritative on his products.

patterns.name: deploy
patterns.note: WordPress deploys are STOP-AND-SHOW. Staging: `bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh [--dry-run]` (.env.wordpress.staging, theme skyyrose-flagship-2, https://staging-7e48-skyyrose.wpcomstaging.com). Production: `bash scripts/deploy-production.sh [--dry-run]` (.env.wordpress, skyyrose.co, theme skyyrose-flagship-2; refuses until WP_THEME_PATH names the -2 folder). scripts/deploy-theme.sh is the engine and refuses direct runs. The V1 theme wordpress-theme/skyyrose-flagship is not the deploy target. Cutover = deploy + `wp theme activate skyyrose-flagship-2`, each STOP-AND-SHOW. Dashboard: Vercel is current but retiring (devskyy.app 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED, 2026-09-18); replacement host undecided.
